dimensionChecks.notes: Product-photo dimensions may describe package projections and different revision rounding. The PCB is not stretched to match the nominal product envelope.

dimensionChecks.activeOffsetBasis: Centered debug window; glass-to-active-edge registration is not calibrated. No mounting/fit claim.

limitations: Preview only: no mechanical-fit, electrical connector insertion, WebGL/browser or hardware firmware validation is implied.
Manufacturer PCB outline, circular holes, thickness, footprint XY and source angle are retained. Copper tracks, vias and silk-screen artwork are not rendered.
Component packages use simplified F.Fab/F.SilkS envelopes with explicitly reported height estimates; external connector mating geometry and hidden contacts remain unverified.
The parent PCB provides only the XIAO module footprint. Its separate internal PCB layout is UNKNOWN; an open USB shell estimate is drawn from photographs.
DNP parts and unplaced off-board footprints are listed and not populated. Noncircular/edge-intersecting drill omissions are separately reported.
No calibrated photograph overlay is claimed. Official front and annotated photographs support component-order/orientation review; source/measured nominal differences are retained.
Open internal Edge.Cuts segments are retained in source and listed in pcbDerivation; unspecified slot/router width is not invented in the preview substrate.
This exact kit choice uses board EE03 and panel SKU 100071485. Bare-board product identity remains separate; same-source geometry does not establish cross-firmware compatibility.
Board and panel are placed side by side for debugging. No case, battery, antenna, wire/FPC routing or mechanical mounting pose is invented.
Panel active and glass XY dimensions come from the retained datasheet; the active-window offset is deliberately centered and not a calibrated reproduction of the unequal border margins.

The display is a simple dimensioned glass/debug surface. Flexible-panel bending, adhesives, laminations and connector mating are not simulated. The FPC tail is omitted rather than converted to a solid extension.
Official reference photographs may use a different rotation from the native framebuffer. The model uses the catalog/runtime native orientation.

sourceIdentity.sharedSourceScope: PCB/manufacturer reference data only; no inherited geometry-review, browser, firmware or hardware acceptance
